note: Alberta Parks recreation area ~30 km southwest of Rocky Mountain House: two loops of sites in spruce forest north of Prairie Creek, with a day-use area. The surrounding area is popular for off-highway vehicles, with trails and informal staging areas outside the campground; offloading or riding OHVs inside the campground is prohibited. Bring firewood. Cell reception is limited. --Claude
